intended_behavior: Add explicit presence to v1 Entity.name at field 2. Each relay and pub/sub subscriber must observe an absent name as JSON null and a present name as its exact string, including an explicitly present empty string. Preserve entity_id, Unicode, whitespace and escaped text exactly. Preserve name presence and value when relaying encoded messages; the standalone sample producers still set their existing nonempty names. v2 has no name and must keep its existing entity_id-only observations. Do not edit tests or generated bindings. Coordinated rollout only; legacy writers cannot distinguish an omitted empty name from absence.
